paper_vocabulary.name: TetherKernel
paper_vocabulary.why: The audit paper names the kernel pairing TetherKernel as the object of the kernel C2 and C3 theorems; the paper side uses that name and writes the hypotheses out.

paper_vocabulary.name: Functional
paper_vocabulary.why: The paper's kernel statements are about functionals on the coadjoint orbit model.

paper_vocabulary.name: CoadjointOrbit
paper_vocabulary.why: The paper's kernel statements are indexed by a coadjoint orbit.

paper_vocabulary.name: KineticEnergyHamiltonian
paper_vocabulary.why: The paper's kernel C2 conclusion is vanishing against the kinetic-energy Hamiltonian.

paper_vocabulary.name: FunctionalDerivative
paper_vocabulary.why: One hypothesis of the kernel C2 theorem is an identification of this derivative with reconstructed velocity.

paper_vocabulary.name: velocity_from_vorticity
paper_vocabulary.why: The reconstructed velocity appearing in the kernel C2 hypotheses.

paper_vocabulary.name: div
paper_vocabulary.why: The divergence-free hypothesis of the kernel C2 theorem.
